moon_south_pole.mission_context: NASA Artemis Program / Candidate Permanent Base Locations

aoi.crs: Moon 2015 South Polar Stereographic (R=1737.4 km, True at 90S, central 0)

relief_20km_m.name: relief_20km_m
relief_20km_m.spatial_resolution: 80 m native, measured in 20 km moving window
relief_20km_m.calculation_method: p95(elevation) - p5(elevation) over 20 km local projected windows
relief_20km_m.aoi: Lunar South Pole (poleward of 85S; r <= 151.8 km)
relief_20km_m.limitations: Extreme crater rim relief dominates over flat plains; no sea level datum.

slope_20km_deg.name: slope_20km_deg
slope_20km_deg.spatial_resolution: 1 km native, mean over 20 km window
slope_20km_deg.calculation_method: Mean gradient magnitude over 20 km window on polar stereographic grid
slope_20km_deg.limitations: Steep internal crater walls (25-35 deg) balanced by rolling inter-crater plateaus.

roughness_5km_m.name: roughness_5km_m
roughness_5km_m.spatial_resolution: 80 m native, evaluated at 5 km window
roughness_5km_m.calculation_method: Standard deviation of high-pass residual (z - Gaussian(z, sigma=2.5 km))
roughness_5km_m.limitations: Impact crater morphology causes higher micro-roughness than typical Earth basalt plateaus.

roughness_10km_m.name: roughness_10km_m
roughness_10km_m.spatial_resolution: 80 m native, evaluated at 10 km window
roughness_10km_m.calculation_method: Standard deviation of high-pass residual (z - Gaussian(z, sigma=5.0 km))
roughness_10km_m.limitations: Reflects kilometer-scale crater rim and wall dissection.

roughness_20km_m.name: roughness_20km_m
roughness_20km_m.spatial_resolution: 1 km native, evaluated at 20 km window
roughness_20km_m.calculation_method: Standard deviation of high-pass residual (z - Gaussian(z, sigma=10.0 km))

hurst_2_32km.name: hurst_2_32km
hurst_2_32km.calculation_method: Half the slope of log(elevation structure function) vs log(lag)
hurst_2_32km.limitations: Self-affine scaling breaks down at primary impact crater diameters.

temp_mean_c.name: temp_mean_c
temp_mean_c.calculation_method: Annual mean bolometric surface temperature (105 K = -168.15 C)
temp_mean_c.limitations: Surface skin temperature in vacuum; Earth equivalent is air temperature.

temp_diurnal_range_c.name: temp_diurnal_range_c
temp_diurnal_range_c.calculation_method: Summer max minus winter min on illuminated rims; near 0 in PSRs
temp_diurnal_range_c.limitations: Extreme bimodal distribution between sunlit ridges and permanent shadows.

temp_min_coldest_c.name: temp_min_coldest_c
temp_min_coldest_c.source: Williams et al. 2019, JGR; Paige et al. 2010 Science
temp_min_coldest_c.aoi: Lunar South Pole PSRs (Hermite, Faustini, Shackleton floor)
temp_min_coldest_c.limitations: Earth cold extremes (-72.5 C in WorldClim / -89.2 C at Vostok) cannot match 40 K cryogenic traps.

temp_annual_range_c.name: temp_annual_range_c
temp_annual_range_c.limitations: Driven by lunar orbit precession and low grazing sun angle (1.5 deg).

psr_coverage_fraction.name: psr_coverage_fraction
psr_coverage_fraction.calculation_method: Sum of PSR polygon areas within 85S-90S / total area (pi * 151.8^2 km2)
psr_coverage_fraction.limitations: Total 18,920.6 km2 of PSRs across 80S tile; concentrated in deep craters.

irreducible_limits.atmosphere: Hard vacuum (< 10^-10 Pa) vs Earth 1013 hPa
irreducible_limits.radiation: Unshielded galactic cosmic rays (GCR) and solar particle events (SPE)
irreducible_limits.illumination: Persistent grazing sun angle (~1.5 deg) producing extreme horizontal shadows

mars_jezero_crater.mission_context: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Landing Site / Sample Caching
mars_jezero_crater.geological_epoch: Late Noachian to Early Hesperian open-basin lake delta (~3.7 Ga)

relief_20km_m.name: relief_20km_m
relief_20km_m.spatial_resolution: 16 ppd (~3.7 km/px), evaluated in 20 km moving window
relief_20km_m.calculation_method: p95(elevation) - p5(elevation) over 20 km regional window
relief_20km_m.limitations: Crater rim scarp creates steep localized relief; crater floor is smooth.

slope_20km_deg.name: slope_20km_deg
slope_20km_deg.calculation_method: Mean gradient magnitude over 20 km window
slope_20km_deg.limitations: Landing ellipse floor slope is ~1.5 deg; delta scarp exceeds 15 deg.

roughness_5km_m.name: roughness_5km_m
roughness_5km_m.spatial_resolution: 16 ppd (~3.7 km native; near spatial resolution boundary)
roughness_5km_m.calculation_method: Standard deviation of high-pass residual (z - Gaussian(z, sigma=2.5 km))
roughness_5km_m.limitations: At 3.7 km pixels, 5 km roughness is near Nyquist limit; flags as limited.

roughness_10km_m.name: roughness_10km_m
roughness_10km_m.calculation_method: Standard deviation of high-pass residual (z - Gaussian(z, sigma=5.0 km))
roughness_10km_m.limitations: Robustly captures delta fan and crater ejecta blockiness.

roughness_20km_m.name: roughness_20km_m
roughness_20km_m.calculation_method: Standard deviation of high-pass residual (z - Gaussian(z, sigma=10.0 km))
roughness_20km_m.limitations: Dominated by the 49 km impact crater rim morphology.

hurst_2_32km.name: hurst_2_32km
hurst_2_32km.calculation_method: Slope of log structure function against log lags 7.4, 14.8, 29.6 km
hurst_2_32km.limitations: Fewer lag points available than on Earth/Moon due to 3.7 km resolution.

temp_mean_c.name: temp_mean_c
temp_mean_c.source: Martinez et al. 2023, JGR Planets (doi:10.1029/2022JE007537); Putzig et al. 2005
temp_mean_c.calculation_method: Annual mean ground temperature (214.2 K = -58.95 C)
temp_mean_c.limitations: Ground-level surface skin temperature under 7.1 hPa CO2 atmosphere.

temp_diurnal_range_c.name: temp_diurnal_range_c
temp_diurnal_range_c.source: Rodriguez-Manfredi et al. 2021; Martinez et al. 2023
temp_diurnal_range_c.calculation_method: Daily difference between afternoon solar maximum and pre-dawn minimum
temp_diurnal_range_c.limitations: Extreme diurnal swing driven by low thermal inertia (340 tiu) and thin air.

temp_min_coldest_c.name: temp_min_coldest_c
temp_min_coldest_c.calculation_method: Coldest winter night minimum ground temperature
temp_min_coldest_c.limitations: Comparable to Antarctic winter high-plateau minima (-80 to -89 C).

temp_annual_range_c.name: temp_annual_range_c
temp_annual_range_c.calculation_method: Annual peak summer maximum minus annual winter minimum
temp_annual_range_c.limitations: Mars eccentric orbit causes large seasonal thermal amplitude.

psr_coverage_fraction.name: psr_coverage_fraction
psr_coverage_fraction.calculation_method: No permanently shadowed regions exist at Jezero latitude (18.4 N)
psr_coverage_fraction.limitations: Cold-trap PSR proxy applies to lunar polar target only.

irreducible_limits.gravity: Mars = 3.71 m/s^2 (0.38g) vs Earth = 9.81 m/s^2. Sediment settling rates in paleolakes were lower on Mars.
irreducible_limits.atmosphere: Mars = ~7.1 hPa pure CO2 vs Earth 1013 hPa N2/O2.
irreducible_limits.radiation: Annual surface dose at Jezero is ~240-260 mSv/yr without magnetic shielding.
irreducible_limits.biology: Jezero delta is pristine abiotic rock; Earth analogs contain active microbial extremophiles.

mars_oxia_planum.mission_context: ESA/Roscosmos/NASA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin Rover Landing Site

relief_20km_m.name: relief_20km_m
relief_20km_m.limitations: Extremely flat depositional plain with isolated remnant buttes.

slope_20km_deg.name: slope_20km_deg
slope_20km_deg.calculation_method: Mean gradient magnitude over 20 km window
slope_20km_deg.limitations: Over 98% of landing ellipse area has slopes < 5 degrees.

roughness_5km_m.name: roughness_5km_m
roughness_5km_m.limitations: Low-relief planar duricrust with low boulder abundance.

hurst_2_32km.name: hurst_2_32km
hurst_2_32km.limitations: Self-affine scaling of deflated alluvial clays.

temp_mean_c.name: temp_mean_c
temp_mean_c.source: Forget et al. 1999 (MCD v6.1); Quantin-Nataf et al. 2021
temp_mean_c.product_id: Mars Climate Database scaled to -3050 m MOLA elevation
temp_mean_c.spatial_resolution: Regional GCM with sub-grid topographic correction
temp_mean_c.calculation_method: Annual mean surface temperature (212.5 K = -60.65 C)

temp_diurnal_range_c.name: temp_diurnal_range_c
temp_diurnal_range_c.source: Christensen et al. 2004; Edwards et al. 2011
temp_diurnal_range_c.calculation_method: Diurnal temperature range for duricrust regolith
temp_diurnal_range_c.limitations: Duricrust has slightly lower diurnal swing than loose sand.

temp_annual_range_c.name: temp_annual_range_c
temp_annual_range_c.calculation_method: Annual peak summer max minus winter min

irreducible_limits.atmosphere: Mars = ~7.55 hPa CO2 vs Earth 1013 hPa N2/O2
irreducible_limits.biology: Abiotic clay sheet exposed to UV-C; Earth analogs contain active microbes.

rover_mobility.description: Prioritizes terrain traverse feasibility, chassis clearance, slope gradients, and multi-scale roughness

cold_trap_ice.description: Prioritizes extreme cryogenic temperatures, persistent cold traps, and volatile stability

thermal_cycling.description: Prioritizes diurnal temperature swings, annual thermal range, and thermal extremes

balanced_default.description: Equalized balance across terrain roughness, slope, temperature, and aridity

relief_20km_m.long_name: Local relief in a 20 km window
relief_20km_m.formula: p95(elevation) - p5(elevation) in 20 km metric window
relief_20km_m.earth_source: ETOPO 2022 60 arc-second via 2 km AEQD grid

slope_20km_deg.long_name: Mean slope in a 20 km window
slope_20km_deg.formula: mean of per-cell gradient magnitude in 20 km window

roughness_5km_m.formula: std(z - Gaussian(z, sigma=2.5 km)) in 5 km window
roughness_5km_m.mars_source: MOLA DEM residual (limited by 3.7 km native pixel; flag if limited)

roughness_10km_m.formula: std(z - Gaussian(z, sigma=5.0 km)) in 10 km window

roughness_20km_m.formula: std(z - Gaussian(z, sigma=10.0 km)) in 20 km window

hurst_2_32km.formula: half the OLS slope of log(structure function) vs log(lag) for lags 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 km
hurst_2_32km.mars_source: MOLA derived where lags >= 7.4 km exist, else flagged

temp_mean_c.mars_source: mars_thermal_literature.csv (Martinez et al. 2023 / Putzig et al. 2005)

temp_min_coldest_c.long_name: Minimum temperature of coldest period (cold-trap proxy)
temp_min_coldest_c.earth_source: WorldClim 2.1 bio_6 (cold-extreme proxy for lunar cold traps)

psr_coverage_fraction.formula: Area of PSR polygons in cell / cell area
psr_coverage_fraction.earth_source: Not directly available; proxied by temp_min_coldest_c and permafrost presence
